messages:
maria: FYI — Nimbus flagged a possible attribution issue: ~30k embeds showed up twice for a few customers (EU edge) between 2025-11-02 and 2025-11-03. They think an extra X-Edge-Region header caused duplicate attribution. Need guidance on whether to backfill credits or adjust invoices. @raj ?
raj: Can you attach a sample of the raw events / query output? Need to see the duplicate pattern before we decide on credits. Also, what's the estimated $ impact?
tess: Quick summary from ops: we saw duplicate downstream rows where `request_id` was identical but `region` differed (eu-west vs eu-central). Looks like vendor proxy added a fallback header on failover. Est count ~29,800 embed rows. Link to query: https://internal/sql/queries/edge-dup-202511.json
liam: We rolled a hotfix last night to dedupe on the ingestion side (compare `request_id` + `model`), so future events should be safe. Log snippet from the roll: ```INFO 2025-11-04 03:12:11 dedupe: dropped 915 events from stream eu-west```
nimbus-support: Sorry about the noise — we traced this to an old proxy rule that duplicated `X-Edge-Region` when a retry happened. We pushed the rule change on 2025-11-04 02:50 UTC and can share headers for a sample request if you want. We also confirmed the extra header only hit EU nodes for that 24h window.
ingest-bot: automated replay job completed: replayed 29,754 events into the accounting pipeline (job-id: replay-2025-11-05-12).
maria: Thanks all. Raj — rough $ calc from product: average embed cost $0.00075 => gross impact ~$22.3. Does finance want to: (A) issue full credit to affected customers, (B) issue partial credit (50%) since some duplicates may be downstream deduped by customer SDKs, or (C) do no credit and mark as operational exception? We need a decision and a short note for invoices.
raj: Given uncertainty and the vendor admission, I'm leaning to partial credit (50%) for the affected invoice period. Need list of affected customer IDs and a signed ack from Nimbus that they caused the duplication. Also please include the CSV with `customer_id,request_id,count,region` so we can run a quick audit.
tess: I can prepare the CSV and run the audit. Suggest we credit customers via a one-line invoice adjustment (credit memo) and also flag the vendor for cost recovery in next month's vendor reconciliation.
maria: Nimbus — can you provide a short confirmation email saying the proxy rule caused duplicate headers for EU nodes between 2025-11-02T00:00:00Z and 2025-11-03T23:59:59Z and that the fix was deployed 2025-11-04T02:50Z? We'll need that for vendor remediation paperwork.
nimbus-support: Confirmed. We'll send a signed statement to finance@redwood.com today with the timeframe and mitigation details.
raj: OK — once we have the CSV and their signed statement, finance approves issuing 50% credit to impacted customers. Tess, please prepare the credit memos and cc legal for vendor recovery.
tess: On it. I'll file credit memos and attach the audit evidence. Estimated completion: EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks everyone — tagging this as resolved for now. If audit finds a different scope, we'll reopen. :wave:
